            for c in range(i, len(row)):
                out[r][c] = 1
    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):

            continue

        for c in range(last + 1, len(row)):
            out[r][c] = 1
    return out
